## apiome tags {#tags}

List and inspect version tags (named pointers to versions).

```text
apiome tags [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`list`](#tags-list), [`show`](#tags-show).

## apiome tags list {#tags-list}

List a project's version tags and the version each points to (GET /v1/version-tags/{tenant}/{project}).

```text
apiome tags list [OPTIONS] PROJECT
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | integer range | `50` |  | Show at most this many tags. |
| `--all` | flag |  |  | Show every tag (ignores --limit). |

## apiome tags show {#tags-show}

Show one version tag: the version it points to, its channel, locks and dates.

The server keeps only the current pointer, so no move history is shown.

```text
apiome tags show [OPTIONS] PROJECT TAG
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `TAG_REF` | text | yes | Tag name (exact) or tag UUID. |
